rationale: Slow first-order + delay with level-dependent drain. E1 u=0.4 decays from 0.38 to 0.28 net -0.01/s late slope -0.003/s so eq~0.25-0.28. E2 u=0 decays 0.28 to 0.05 at ~0.0156/s. E8 u=0 from 0.64 decays after 2s flat at ~0.025-0.029/s so drain rises with level. E3 u=0.7 rises 0.04 to 0.24 at ~0.020/s after 2-4s flat. E4 u=1.0 rises 0.25 to 0.45 at 0.039/s immediate. E5/E6/E10/E11 u=0.6 climbs 0.45 to 0.63 at ~0.012-0.023/s still rising at 0.6, while E7 u=0.5 holds 0.63-0.64 flat, so hold-u for 0.6 is 0.50-0.60. Gross pump ~0.05-0.059/s per unit u, drain at 0.6 ~0.027/s => ff~0.49-0.55. DC gain ~1.6-1.9, tau ~12-17s, cold delay 2-4s from zero, 0.5-1s warm, noise +/-0.01-0.02. Therefore feedforward 0.54 + PI correcting residual, filtered P+D for damping, ramped setpoint 0.03/s to avoid kick and overshoot, conditional integration with +/-0.22 clamp to avoid windup during 0/1 saturation, safety caps below 0.85/0.9. Kp=0.9 Ki=0.08 gives Ti=11s ~tau, crossover ~0.1 rad/s stable with 2s delay.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir: positive gain, no dead-zone. Pump raises level, self-drains to near-zero at u=0. Drain ~0.015/s at y~0.15 (E2), ~0.02/s at y~0.35 (E9 dip), ~0.025-0.029/s at y~0.5-0.64 (E8). Pump gross ~0.055/s per unit u (E4 net 0.039 + drain). Net with u=0.4 at 0.3 is ~-0.003/s eq~0.27; with u=0.6 at 0.45-0.6 is +0.007 to +0.023/s eq>=0.65; with u=0.7 +0.027/s; with u=1.0 +0.039/s. So steady y highly sensitive between u=0.4 and 0.6, hold for 0.6 needs u~0.50-0.57. Dynamics: 2-4s cold-start flat/dip from u=0 (E3,E9), 0.5-1s when already pumping (E4,E5,E10,E11), lag/time-constant 5-15s. Noise +/-0.01-0.02 on 0.10 band. No threshold: u=0.4 slows decay vs u=0.
